it.name: RISE: Sleep Tracker
it.d:
Join over 10 million users! Become a better sleeper and morning person thanks to 100 years of sleep science with RISE, the only sleep tracker that also measures your sleep debt and energy levels.

Recommended by the Sleep Foundation and trusted by teams in the NFL, MLB, and NBA, and top Fortune 500 companies, RISE makes it easy to improve your sleep and energy.

But RISE is more than a sleep and energy tracker. Users can access widgets, calendar integration, sleeping sounds, meditation guides, smart alarm clocks, habit reminders, and a sleep knowledge library.

FROM THE RISE COMMUNITY

***
Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."

***
Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."


UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.

Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.

RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?

Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm and research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits.

RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.

DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up. We use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep windows.

You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and energy levels, helping you plan for a productive day.

Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.

AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.

WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).

Today, we look at sleep as a luxury. RISE strives to create a world where healthy sleep is a necessity.

Subscription pricing & terms
RISE offers auto-renewing yearly subscriptions to provide unlimited access to all premium features. There’s also a limited-time free trial of 7 days to explore the premium features for free. A Paid Subscription (or free trial) is required to access the content of the app.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your App Store account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Go to your Profile or App Store settings to manage your subscription.

Terms of Service available at: bit.ly/rise-sleep-app-tos

CREATE COLLAGE MAGIC (COLLAGE MAKER)

From solopreneurs to graphic design enthusiasts, AI art pioneers, and photo editors — share your ideas and get inspiration for your next project with Picsart Spaces.

UPGRADE YOUR DESIGN EXPERIENCE

Rashaqa is an app for health and wellness

Rashaqa is an all-in-one health and fitness app that offers several advantages to its users. Among its features, the Calories Scanner stands out as a powerful tool for managing your diet and achieving your health goals. Here’s what you need to know:
Calorie Tracking:
Rashaqa provides you with a calorie tracker program for all your meals. Whether you’re following a specific diet plan, practicing intermittent fasting, or simply aiming for weight loss, this feature has you covered.
By accurately calculating the calories for each meal you consume, Rashaqa helps you stay on track with your dietary goals.
It also includes easy and quick healthy recipes suitable for various diets.
Healthy Diet Plans:
Specify your goal—whether it’s weight gain, weight loss, or muscle building—and Rashaqa will choose an appropriate meal plan for your health condition.
These meal plans have been thoughtfully developed by nutritionists who specialize in creating healthy diets tailored to individual needs.
With over 400 meal plans, you can customize your food choices and track your intake effectively.
Home Workouts:
Rashaqa offers a comprehensive home workout service. You’ll have your virtual fitness coach guiding you through fat-burning exercises.
Whether you’re aiming for weight loss or overall fitness, these home workouts are designed to help you achieve your goals.
Make the most of your fitness time with Rashaqa’s exercise plans. 
Steps Counter (Pedometer):
Rashaqa walks with you step by step, tracking and recording your steps and statistics.
Whether you’re walking or running, every step counts toward your overall activity level.
Water Alarm:
Staying hydrated is crucial during workouts. Rashaqa reminds you to drink water regularly to replenish lost fluids.
The app determines the appropriate water intake based on your weight and daily needs.
Additional Exercises:
Rashaqa provides various exercise options, including:
Treadmill: Calculate your steps using the step counter during treadmill workouts.
Stationary Bike: Burn calories and lose weight with fat-burning exercises at home.
Running in Place: A simple yet effective home exercise for weight loss.
In summary, Rashaqa combines calorie tracking, diet planning, home workouts, and step counting—all in one convenient app. Transform your health today with Rashaqa!

it.name: Tripsy: Travel Planner
it.d:
Tripsy is a travel planner and itinerary organizer that brings your flights, hotels, activities, reservations, and travel expenses together in one place.

Build a day-by-day trip itinerary, plan routes between stops, and share your travel plans with family and friends. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a road trip, a business trip, or a vacation across several cities, keep the details organized and your plans close at hand—even offline.

PLAN YOUR DAYS WITH SMART ROUTES
See estimated travel times and distances between activities, with routes that fit your schedule. Set arrival buffers for flights and other plans, and see when your schedule leaves too little travel time. Your transportation choices stay saved and sync across your devices.

BUILD ROUTES WITH MULTIPLE STOPS
Add and reorder stops, choose how to travel on each leg, and see estimated arrival times along the way. View your route on the map and open directions in your preferred navigation app. Save frequently used addresses, such as home, work, or a favorite hotel, to use in future plans.

SMART IMPORT
Turn screenshots, documents, pasted text, Google Maps and Apple Maps lists, and supported web or social links into places and reservations. Review and edit before importing. Smart Import uses online processing and requires Tripsy Pro on supported system versions. You can also forward booking emails or import travel plans from TripIt.

BRING YOUR CALENDARS TOGETHER
See events from your selected calendars alongside your trip itinerary, and add them as activities when needed. Sync your Tripsy itinerary to your calendar to keep travel plans visible in your daily schedule.

PLAN AND TRAVEL TOGETHER
Invite family, friends, or colleagues to collaborate on a trip or follow along with view-only access. Choose who can edit plans and access documents or expenses. Save favorite guests to make planning your next trip together easier.

STAY INFORMED ON THE GO
Receive flight updates for delays, gates, terminals, and baggage claims. Check 10-day weather forecasts, keep track of local time zones, and access your itinerary offline when you don't have a connection.

SMART INSIGHTS
Find baggage, breakfast, parking, and cancellation details from attached documents and emails right in your activities. Review suggested costs before saving. Analysis runs on your device and requires Apple Intelligence.

KEEP YOUR TRAVEL DETAILS CLOSE
Keep reservation emails, documents, photos, links, and notes with your trip. Personalize each trip with a cover image or color.

TRACK EXPENSES AND LOOK BACK ON YOUR TRAVELS
Record travel expenses in multiple currencies, let guests add their own expenses, and keep track of spending throughout your trip. Export itineraries, activity lists, and expenses to CSV. With Tripsy Book, explore your travel statistics, including countries visited, hotel nights, flight time, and distance traveled.

PLAN WITH YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Connect Tripsy to a compatible AI assistant to create trips, add activities, and update your itinerary through conversation.

Tripsy is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, with cloud sync to keep your trips up to date across your devices.

Tripsy is free to download. Some features require Tripsy Pro, available as a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Service: https://tripsy.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tripsy.app/policy

it.name: komoot - hike, bike & run
it.d:
Turn your next ride, hike, or run into an adventure with komoot. Get inspired by tapping into shared community knowledge and recommendations, then bring your adventures to life with the easy route planner.

PLAN YOUR PERFECT HIKING, MOUNTAIN BIKING OR ROAD CYCLING ADVENTURE
Get the route perfect for your sport—be it smooth asphalt for your road bike, singletracks for your mountain bike, silent cycling paths for touring or natural trails for your hikes. Plan down to the last detail with at-your-fingertips info like surface, difficulty, distance and elevation profile.

TURN-BY-TURN VOICE NAVIGATION
Never take your eyes off the road with turn-by-turn voice navigation: your precise, down-to-the-inch verbal navigator that doesn’t distract you from your surroundings. Keep your eyes firmly on the adventure in front of you and navigate with ease, even on small trails or in the woods.

OFFLINE MAPS FOR OUTDOOR ADVENTURES
Download your planned outdoor adventures and save topographic maps with one tap. Navigate the outdoors even when the internet is down or unreliable. Differentiate hiking paths, MTB singletracks or paved roads, terrain and land cover at a glance.

BROWSE HIGHLIGHTS: THE KOMOOT COMMUNITY’S FAVOURITE PLACES
So you can decide on the destination of your next adventure at a glance, see Highlights on the map. From peaks, parks, and points of interest, to singletracks and sandwich shops, these places or segments, showing up as red dots in the planner, are the spots other users think you should check out. And if you’re in the know, you can recommend your own to the community in turn and inspire others to visit your favourite places, too.

TELL YOUR STORY
Track your rides and hikes with GPS. Add photos, Highlights and tips and build your own personal adventure log that’ll store your favourite experiences—forever. Save them for private use or share them with the komoot community to receive likes and comments and to inspire fellow outdoor folks. Follow your friends and like-minded explorers to keep up with their outdoor adventures.

BE A LOCAL EXPERT. BECOME A PIONEER.
Contribute photos, tips and Highlights to the community and show you’re a local Expert. Earn more upvotes than in any else for your sport in your region and become the Pioneer!

SEAMLESS SYNC ACROSS EVERY DEVICE
Whether you prep like a pro on your desktop or plan a route on the go, komoot automatically syncs your routes, tracked adventures and photos across all devices, including your smartphone, desktop, iPad and Apple Watch. Use a Garmin or a Wahoo? Simply download the komoot for Garmin app in the IQ Store and sync your profiles via Garmin Connect, or connect your komoot and Wahoo accounts to share Tours with the ELEMNT and ELEMNT BOLT.

EXPERIENCE KOMOOT FOR FREE
When you download komoot, your first region is free—forever. To expand the areas in which komoot has your back, conveniently choose between single regions, region bundles or the World Pack to access offline maps and turn-by-turn voice navigation wherever you go.

APPLE WATCH
Take a quick glance at your Apple Watch to get directions, distance, and speed in real-time—right on your wrist.

APPLE HEALTH
You can connect komoot to Health to ensure your data is always up-to-date. Automatically share your time and distance data for komoot hiking, cycling, and running activities with Health.


“Komoot does for hiking and biking what Apple does for hardware: makes it easily accessible and fun to use.”  
— Cult of Mac


For support and tips, please visit help.komoot.de


MORE INFORMATION
Komoot uses background audio service for voice navigation messages.
Komoot requires a GPS signal for directions, Tour recording and speed in real-time.

Calm is the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation. Find anxiety relief, stress relief, and better sleep through breathing exercises, sleep sounds, deep sleep music, and mindfulness programs for insomnia, beginner meditation, and beyond. Downloaded by 180 million people worldwide.

Fall asleep faster with Sleep Stories, bedtime stories for adults narrated by Matthew McConaughey, Stephen Fry, P\!nk, Bob Ross, and more. Only on Calm.

Manage stress, relieve anxiety, improve your sleep cycle, and refocus your attention.

Apple App of the Year. Apple Editors' Choice. Happiest App in the World (Center for Humane Technology). 3M+ five-star reviews. Recommended by top psychologists, therapists, and mental health experts.

SLEEP STORIES — ONLY ON CALM

* Drift off to Matthew McConaughey's Wonder — a dreamy journey through the mysteries of the universe  
* Travel through the village of Provence with master storyteller Stephen Fry in Blue Gold  
* Fall asleep to the soothing brush strokes of beloved painter Bob Ross in Happy Little Zzzs  
* Tackle insomnia with 100+ exclusive Sleep Stories, new content added every month

MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

* Beginner meditation to advanced practice — guided sessions for every experience level  
* Daily Calm with Tamara Levitt, Daily Jay with Jay Shetty, Daily Trip with Jeff Warren  
* Mindfulness topics: deep sleep, anxiety relief, stress relief, focus, breaking habits, self-care, personal growth, and more  
* 7- and 21-day mindfulness programs to build a lasting practice

ANXIETY RELIEF & RELAXATION

* Breathing exercises and breathwork to ease anxiety, stress, and insomnia  
* Bilateral stimulation music and neuroacoustic sounds for nervous system regulation and somatic relaxation  
* Guided breathwork for stress relief, anxiety relief, and deep calm  
* Stress management and self-healing through Dailies: programs for social anxiety, personal growth, and mood balance  
* Mindful movement and stretching with Daily Move

SLEEP SOUNDS, MUSIC & SOUNDSCAPES

* Calming music, nature sounds, and sleep sounds: ocean waves, heavy rain, campfire, and more  
* Exclusive focus and sleep music from top artists  
* Full soundscapes and sleep sounds to help you relax, meditate, and sleep soundly

ALSO FEATURING

* Daily Streaks & Mindful Minutes — emotion and mental health tracker  
* Calm saves your meditation and sleep sessions to your Apple Health app.

Mental health is health. Calm is for anyone looking to improve their sleep, manage stress, and address everyday anxiety. Meditation novice or seasoned expert.

Take a deep breath and find your Calm.

Calm is free to download and use. There are never any ads and some of the programs and features are free forever. Some content is only available through an optional paid subscription. Be sure to check out our Apple Watch app to quick-start breathing exercises and track your meditations.

it.name: Wikiloc - Trails of the World
it.d:
Discover millions of outdoor trails around the world. Choose between hiking, running, bike, MTB, kayak, ski or up to 80 different types of activities.

Record your own routes on a map, add waypoints, take pictures along the itinerary and upload them to your Wikiloc account from your phone.

Enjoy free offline topographic maps from all over the world for you to use without coverage or data. Great when you're out in the mountains or traveling without Internet connection.

Want to take your outdoor experiences even further? With Wikiloc Premium:

- Turn your mobile into a GPS navigator. Your smartphone will guide you with a heading indicator and sound alerts to warn you if you go off-track during navigation.
- Route Planner: Choose the places you want to pass through and Wikiloc will create a route prioritizing the most popular stretches of trails from other community members.
- 3D Maps: Without leaving home, discover the terrain relief, evaluate elevation changes, and take a look at the panoramic views that await you along the way.
- Live Tracking. Share your position in real time with your family & friends while doing the route.
- Send to your GPS: Download trails from Wikiloc directly to your Garmin, Apple Watch, Suunto or COROS. Feature available for compatible devices.
- Search by Passing Area: Find trails passing through your chosen specific areas.
- Weather forecast for a perfect outdoor activity.
- Advanced search filters.

By purchasing Wikiloc Premium you’ll be contributing in helping us out to maintain Wikiloc’s infrastructure. 
Furthermore, you’ll also contribute protecting the earth, as 1% of your purchase will directly go to 1% for the Planet, a global network of businesses, nonprofits, and individuals working together for a healthy planet.

Wikiloc Premium is available with a quarterly or annual subscription. 

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the trial period if applicable. Wikiloc Premium subscriptions automatically renew. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period unless you decide to cancel your subscription renewal at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by going to your user Account Settings after the purchase. For your convenience, we also provide links to manage your subscription from your Wikiloc Profile > Settings, that you can access from both web or app.

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Wikiloc for Apple Watch uses HealthKit to save your Wikiloc activities into the Health app and to read the heart rate and active energy data. Most popular Wikiloc activities have an equivalent Apple workout and will be saved into the Health app.

Terms of use: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/terms_en.html?v6.0
Privacy policy: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/privacy.html?v4.1

Join us at Wikiloc.com, the community where millions of nature, travel and sports lovers share their adventures, from the most popular excursion to the most remote expedition on the planet.
